verdict.rationale: The axis applies: CRA publishes extensive web documentation and could ship an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index. The probe shows https://www.canada.ca/llms.txt redirects to the canada.ca 404 error page, and nothing else in the pack shows agent-oriented docs. The other evidence covers business registration and EFILE, which are human-facing or certified-software channels rather than agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
